interpretation_note: matched_winner_rate close to the UNCONDITIONAL block winner rate (~41.8%, from sec12) means entry-state features alone do not distinguish these losers from same-state peers -- i.e. no early-available signal separates them, consistent with 'the loss is the cost of capturing the right tail'. A matched_winner_rate well BELOW the unconditional rate would instead suggest genuine entry-state fragility worth a future preregistered study.
